== fix

exit=0
== unecc
stripped 8 pages -> <w>/raw2.bin (4096 bytes raw)
exit=0
== usage
usage:
  nandtool info   <img>              page/geometry summary
  nandtool verify <img>              check every page's ECC
  nandtool unecc  <img> <out>        strip spare -> raw 512-page data
  nandtool ecc    <raw> <out>        add spare + ECC -> flash image
  nandtool fix    <img> <out>        recompute all ECC in place
exit=0
